Inbound from ops lead (Seth, CTO) after webinar. Small SMB building a call-summary widget that plugs into CRMs. Interested in hosted API (self-serve), want to avoid managing infra. Key concerns: PII + retention.

- Prospect: Transcriptly (start-up, sales enablement).
- Contact: Seth Moreno (CTO), emails: seth@transcriptly.ai, PM: Lina Park (lina@).
- Use-case: live call transcription -> short summary + action items delivered to CRM. weight on low-latency short summaries (200-300 token outputs). Also indexing transcripts for search.
- Preferred flow: client-side streaming to Redwood hosted API, return summary, then persist only anonymized summary. They want option to never store raw transcript on Redwood side (stream-only / ephemeral).
- PII requirements: automatic redaction for SSNs/cards/emails on ingest; ability to toggle redaction rules per-customer; audit log of redaction events. Legal asked: can Redwood provide redaction-at-ingest + proof of deletion?
- Retention questions: default retention windows, per-customer retention override, retention-by-channel (sales vs support), hard delete SLA.
- Compliance ask: SOC2 report required for procurement sign-off; KMS support and audit_logging important but not mandatory for initial POC.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB price-conscious. Asking about token pricing and bundle discounts if usage > 50k tokens/mo.
- Routing: single-region US preferred. fallback model acceptable if cost vs latency tradeoff.

Quoted from call: "We can't have full transcripts sitting around in plaintext — legal will kill us. If you can show ephemeral streaming + redaction proofs, we can run a 30-day pilot."
